```{r libraries}
library(rgbif)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(readr)
library(magrittr)
```

Data from these datasets can be used to determine the status of the nests in

WALLONIA: DEMNA-DNE : Early warning system on Introduced Species in Wallonia: https://www.gbif.org/dataset/04871911-1b00-41f3-8dc6-fc0cea421f96
BRUSSELS: iNaturalist Research-grade Observations: https://www.gbif.org/dataset/50c9509d-22c7-4a22-a47d-8c48425ef4a7

```{r download data from gbif}
taxonkeys <- c(1311477)

gbif_downloadKey <- occ_download(pred_in("taxonKey", taxonkeys),
                                 pred_within(bel),
                                 user = Sys.getenv("gbif_user"),
                                 pwd = Sys.getenv("gbif_pwd"),
                                 email = Sys.getenv("email"),
                                 curlopts = list(verbose = TRUE,
                                                 http_version = 2,
                                                 forbid_reuse = TRUE))

occ_download_wait(gbif_downloadKey, 
                  curlopts = list(verbose = TRUE,
                                  http_version = 2,
                                  forbid_reuse = TRUE))

gbif_download <- occ_download_get(gbif_downloadKey,
                                  path = tempdir(),
                                  overwrite = TRUE,
                                  curlopts = list(verbose = TRUE,
                                                  http_version = 2,
                                                  forbid_reuse = TRUE))

rawdata <- occ_download_import(x = gbif_download) %>% 
  write_csv2("./data/input/Vespa-Watch_gbif.csv")
```
